The quickest way to reach us is email: support@rdydeck.com. We read every message and reply to questions as soon as we can.

From inside the app

Open Help and feedback and tap Send feedback. It opens an email to us in your own email app, already filled in with the RdyDeck version, the screen you were on and your device type, which helps us find a bug quickly. You can include your current deck list by ticking Include my list. You can change or delete anything before you press Send, and nothing is sent until you do.

What helps us most

  • A grade that looks wrong: include the deck list and say which finding or number seems off. Card roles are read from card text, and these reports are how mistakes get fixed.
  • A card that shows the wrong name, type or legality: say which card and which printing, with its set code and number.
  • A bug: say what you tapped, what you expected and what happened instead, and on which device.
  • An idea: tell us what you were trying to do. Many of RdyDeck's features started as a player's request.

Business and legal

RdyDeck is run by Optume Ventures LLC, a Pennsylvania limited liability company. To have a feedback email deleted, email support@rdydeck.com with the subject Delete my data, as Delete your data explains. For other privacy questions, rights requests or anything legal, email mmmilliard@optumeventures.com. The privacy policy and terms of service say more.
